newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile 11-month financial sector earnings up 29 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chile 11-month financial sector earnings up 29 pct.

text.p: Chile's financial sector reported net earnings in the first 11 months of the year of 257.5 billion pesos, up 29 percent from the same period last year, said the Banks and Financial Institutions Superintendency.
The figures show profit growth rising sharply from October, when the sector reported net earnings up six percent from the first 10 months of last year.
Loan portfolios grew 12.6 percent last month, with trade loans up 9.9 percent and consumer credit soaring 31.5 percent.
The following are the net earnings of individual banks in the first 11 months of the year to November compared with the same period 1995.
NOTES: Banco de Chile figure takes into account subordinated debt repayment. Net 11-month profits before the payment were 63.91 billion pesos.
All figures are in billions of pesos. The November 1995 figures are in peso terms from that month and are not expressed in 1996 pesos.
